fields.label: APPID
fields.description: The APPID for a CaptainBI API authorization. Create one under Authorization > Captain API: https://www.captainbi.com/amz_faq_list-216.html.

actions.name: get_business_report
actions.description: Get CaptainBI product traffic, order, conversion, and sales metrics.

openChannelId.description: The CaptainBI OpenChannelId returned by list_stores for the target store.

page.description: The one-based page number. Defaults to 1.

rows.description: The number of records to return. Defaults to 100.

startCreateTime.description: A CaptainBI Unix timestamp in seconds or milliseconds. The start and end timestamps must use the same unit.

endCreateTime.description: A CaptainBI Unix timestamp in seconds or milliseconds. The start and end timestamps must use the same unit.

inputSchema.description: The store, pagination, and creation-time window for a CaptainBI business report.

id.description: The CaptainBI business report record identifier.

visits.description: The number of product visits returned by CaptainBI.

buyerVisitPercentage.description: The percentage of visits attributed to buyers.

buyBoxWinRate.description: The buy box winning rate returned by CaptainBI.

b2bUnitsOrdered.description: The B2B quantity of goods ordered.

sales.description: The sales amount for ordered goods.

b2bSales.description: The B2B sales amount for ordered goods.

items.description: A normalized CaptainBI product business metric.

metrics.description: The metrics returned for this page.

page.description: The one-based page number used for this request.

anyOf.description: The total number of records when CaptainBI reports max_result.

total.description: The total number of records when CaptainBI reports max_result.

anyOf.description: Whether more records exist when CaptainBI reports a total, otherwise null.

hasMore.description: Whether more records exist when CaptainBI reports a total, otherwise null.

anyOf.description: The message returned by CaptainBI, or null when absent.

message.description: The message returned by CaptainBI, or null when absent.

outputSchema.description: A page of CaptainBI product business metrics.
